name: Fuentemolinos (Spain)
description: Square flag of four horizontal stripes, red, yellow, white and blue, the middle two broader, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuentemolinos (a castle, grapes and a millstone above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Fuentemolinos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Fuentemolinos arms — castle, grapes and millstone above waves
